content:
The left is giddy over the fact that Stephen Miller, the former senior adviser to then-President Donald
Trump
, is melting down due to President Joe Biden's decision to end his presidential campaign.
Miller appeared on
Fox News
on Sunday, where he went off on a rant about the Democratic votes were thrown away as the party rallies around Vice President
Kamala Harris.
"They held a primary. They had ballots. They filled out circles!" Miller shouted on Fox News. "They went to the voting booths. They spent money on advertisements!"
Exclusive:
Harris? Newsom? Whitmer? GOP delegates dish on who they want Trump to face
Still yelling, Miller says that Republicans also spent money running against Biden.
"They just woke up one morning and said we are cancelling our entire primary. We're getting rid of our candidate," he added.
Some social media users loved watching Miller's Fox rant.
"
STRAIGHT. INTO. MY.
F------. VEINS," law professor Lee Kovarsky said.
@Out5p0ken
said, "And there it is — official confirmation that this was the right move."
@DogginTrump
said, "I’m confused, I thought all these greasy motherf------ didn’t want an old dude. Looks like they’re stuck with one now."
@Folkmusings_
chimed in, "I thought he was going to break out in full German there for a minute."
Journalist
Andrea Chalupa
said Sunday, "A Black woman is about to become president, and Stephen Miller is having a meltdown."
@elysiumdesigns
said, "Ask yourself this... Why is Stephen Miller whining and literally freaking out on National television?"
Columnist
Molly Jong-Fast
asked, "Is Stephen miller okay?"
